chassagne_bivb_2011_claims.authority: Bureau Interprofessionnel des Vins de Bourgogne / homologated national specification
chassagne_bivb_2011_claims.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Chassagne-Montrachet homologué par décret n°2011-1753
chassagne_bivb_2011_claims.scope: Effective specification authorizes the listed Premier Cru climat names for wines meeting Premier Cru production conditions.

rules.notes: The effective Chassagne-Montrachet specification authorizes the 55 listed Premier Cru climat names. The appellation itself covers white and red wines; the same Premier Cru list applies to both color paths.
